description: This file defines a client-side storage class 'Store' for managing a 'todos' collection, including methods for finding, retrieving, saving, removing, and dropping data, with in-memory storage and support for callbacks.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: A class for managing client-side storage of todo items, supporting CRUD operations and in-memory persistence.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new Store instance, creating storage if it doesn't exist, and optionally executes a callback with current data.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds todos matching a query object and executes a callback with the results.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all todos and executes a callback with the data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates a todo item; generates a new ID if needed; executes callback after operation.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a todo item by ID and executes a callback with the updated list.

methods.name: drop
methods.description: Clears all storage data and executes a callback.
